questions.stem: A 60-year-old man presented to emergency with chest pain, radiating to the left arm for last 15 minutes. Blood examination shows normal levels troponin and creatinine Kinase enzymes. The doctors at the emergency room successfully save the patient with treatment. If it would have been possible to examine microscopic sections during the episode which of the following would have been most likely cellular change?
questions.stemHtml: A 60-year-old man presented to emergency with chest pain, radiating to the left arm for last 15 minutes. Blood examination shows normal levels troponin and creatinine Kinase enzymes. The doctors at the emergency room successfully save the patient with treatment. If it would have been possible to examine microscopic sections during the episode which of the following would have been most likely cellular change?

options.label: A
options.text: Cell swelling, pyknosis, swelling of endoplasmic reticulum.

options.label: B
options.text: Cell swelling, membrane blebs, membrane damage.

options.label: C
options.text: Cells swelling, membrane blebs, hydropic change.
